t: 阿尔比根斯十字军第一次重大军事行动.
te: The first major military action of the Albigensian Crusade.
dz: 贝塞尔大屠杀:阿尔比根斯十字军第一次重大军事行动.
de: Massacre at Béziers: The first major military action of the Albigensian Crusade.

t: 卡卡松的卡特堡垒倒向了十字军.
te: The Cathar stronghold of Carcassonne falls to the crusaders.
dz: 阿尔比根斯十字军:卡卡松的卡特堡垒倒向了十字军.
de: Albigensian Crusade: The Cathar stronghold of Carcassonne falls to the crusaders.

t: 奥托四世被教宗英诺森三世加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝.
te: Otto IV is crowned Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire by Pope Innocent III.
dz: 奥托四世被教宗英诺森三世加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝.
de: Otto IV is crowned Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire by Pope Innocent III.
